properties.description:
Two halves, both in the graph rather than in prose.

THE COUNT. `VerificationCoverage` carries `capabilities_verified_by_runnable_check` beside `capabilities_verified`, computed by `has_runnable_passing_verification` — an incoming VERIFIES from a Verification that PASSES and has something IMPLEMENTing it. The coverage report says it as its own sentence, and says it when it is zero: "Of the 241 verified, 21 rest on a check something can re-run and 220 on a claim nothing implements." Folded into the existing line it would have been a parenthesis beside another parenthesis; alone it is the sentence somebody quotes.

THE RATCHET. `tools/check_verification_ratchet.py`, run in CI against the committed export, fails the build when a capability NEWLY claims a passing check nothing implements. The 220 already in that state on 2026-09-22 are grandfathered by id on `dec:a-capability-may-not-newly-reach-verified-on-a-claim-alone` — a SET and not a count, because a count stays still while one claim is earned and another introduced, and IN THE GRAPH rather than in the script, because a list inside `tools/` could be edited to silence a finding without surfacing in a design review. Both arguments are `cap:intent-authority-is-checked`'s, unchanged; this is that shape applied to assurance.

WHAT IT FORBIDS IS THE CLAIM, NOT THE ABSENCE. A capability with no check at all is unverified and honest and passes: capture-intent records intent before anything is built, and a gate that fired on that would answer the day-one-cliff question with "switch it off".

IT DOES NOT JUDGE A CHECK. `dec:non-goal-reflow2-does-not-judge-whether-a-check-is-meaningful` stands. It reports a fact the graph already held — the same signal `has_executable_form` has carried in the loop digest all along — and refuses to let that fact get worse.

IT CANNOT PASS QUIETLY. No ruling, an unsettled ruling, a missing baseline field, an export with no capabilities, an unreadable export — every way of not knowing exits 2. Five of its twelve tests exist only to pin that.

FOUND WHILE BUILDING IT, and recorded because it is a plausible cause of the 220: `link_artifact` draws REALIZES and only REALIZES, whatever the target type. So the discoverable route — "register the file that is the check" — produces an artifact pointing at the Verification and NO executable form. The IMPLEMENTS edge is a second, separate `create_edge`, and nothing in the tool's own reply says it is owed.
properties.name: "Verified" splits into a check something re-runs and a check somebody typed, and the split only ever narrows
